title: Question 17
passage:
Which bus stops at the swimming pool on Sundays?
A. The pool closes at six on weekdays. B. There’s a shelter across the road. C. Take the number eight.
passageZh:
星期日哪一路公車會停靠游泳池？
A. 游泳池平日六點關門。 B. 馬路對面有候車亭。 C. 搭八號公車。
